column1: # Which host variables each EXEC SQL statement reads from the program and which it writes back,
# as Db2 for z/OS's SQL reference gives them: INTO, FETCH INTO and SET's targets are written, an
# indicator with its variable; every other host variable is read. Tab-separated: the statement,
# then the variables read and those written, space-separated in the order they appear, - for none.
# ironwork vendors this file (fixtures/cobolwork/sql/) and its tests read the same rows.
SELECT NAME, AMT INTO :WS-NAME, :WS-AMT:WS-IND FROM EMP WHERE ID = :WS-ID
SELECT NAME INTO :WS-NAME INDICATOR :WS-IND FROM EMP WHERE ID = :WS-ID
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :WS-N FROM EMP WHERE DEPT IN (:WS-D1, :WS-D2)
SELECT NAME INTO :WS-NAME FROM EMP WHERE ID = :WS-ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT NAME INTO :WS-NAME FROM EMP WHERE ID = :WS-ID WITH UR
SELECT NAME INTO :EMP-REC.NAME FROM EMP WHERE ID = :EMP-REC.ID
SELECT ID, NAME INTO :EMP-REC FROM EMP WHERE ID = :WS-ID
VALUES CURRENT DATE INTO :WS-DATE
SET :WS-TOTAL = :WS-A + :WS-B
SET :WS-N = :WS-N + 1
INSERT INTO EMP (ID, NAME) VALUES (:WS-ID, :WS-NAME:WS-IND)
INSERT INTO EMP SELECT * FROM NEWEMP WHERE DEPT = :WS-DEPT
UPDATE EMP SET AMT = :WS-AMT WHERE ID = :WS-ID
UPDATE EMP SET (AMT, NAME) = (:WS-AMT, :WS-NAME) WHERE ID = :WS-ID
UPDATE EMP SET AMT = :WS-AMT WHERE CURRENT OF C1
DELETE FROM EMP WHERE ID = :WS-ID
DELETE FROM EMP WHERE CURRENT OF C1
DECLARE C1 CURSOR FOR SELECT NAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPT = :WS-DEPT
DECLARE C2 CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR SELECT NAME FROM EMP WHERE AMT > :WS-AMT ORDER BY NAME
OPEN C1
FETCH C1 INTO :WS-NAME, :WS-AMT:WS-IND
CLOSE C1
